  2. Run documentation generator/static/integration/browser tests separately from the real game suite. Review content license, unresolved art/API gates, accessibility and localization status.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. On independent machines/processes execute Slice A, then the entire Slice B route, then Slice C party/dungeon/social/restart/zone/economy scenarios.
  2. Repeat with keyboard/mouse and controller focus, text scaling, reduced cosmetic effects and two localized text-length fixtures; the shared server never pauses when a client opens options.
  3. Record exact executable/build/content/schema IDs, commands, network conditions, server/backend receipts and observed outcomes.
  4. Review remaining release blockers and sign off only the tested population/platform/content scope.
Expected success
Packaged gameplay, durability, security/recovery, UI and measured operating budgets pass with retained evidence; documentation checks alone cannot satisfy this gate.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Mass concurrency, optional auction/PvP/raid/housing/monetization and unverified mounted/eight-direction art remain outside release claims until separately implemented/tested.

Expected rejection and concurrency results

SystemStimulus -> expected outcome
current-phase fixtureAny dupe, stale-session write, unauthorized access, corrupt migration, missing required content or unresolved packaging/compatibility gate blocks release.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Slice C requires retained test evidence, recovery proof and no unresolved critical economy failures.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
